member.noDevicesSuspended: No devices. Suspended members can’t add any.

network.suspended: Blocked until the member is reactivated
network.mutual: Can reach devices that also allow mutual access
network.isolated: Internet only, isolated from other devices

row.networkInactiveHint: Not routed: the VPS sends these ranges through another of its networks.
row.networksUnreachable: No other device can reach these until {{name}} allows mutual access or is paired.
row.lastOwnerDevice: The last Owner device can’t be revoked.
row.lastOwnerHelp: Add another Owner device first, or transfer ownership from another member’s menu.

invite.title: Invite member
invite.description: Create a code for someone to join this VPN.
invite.descriptionNamed: Create a code for someone to join this VPN. They name themselves and their device when joining.
invite.descriptionSelf: Create a code, then use it on your new device.
invite.descriptionForMember: Create a code for {{name}}’s new device.
invite.descriptionReady: Send this code to the person you’re inviting.
invite.descriptionReadyDevice: Use this code on the new device.
invite.onceTitle: This code is shown only once
invite.secretWarning: Anyone with it can join until it’s used, cancelled or expired. Share it privately.
invite.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the code. Select it and copy it manually.
invite.copyFailedAndroid: Couldn’t copy the code. Use View or share invitation to send it instead.

closeUnshared.title: Close without sharing the code?
closeUnshared.message: It can’t be shown again. If you haven’t copied, scanned or shared it, cancel this invitation and create a new one.

invite.roleHint: Admins can invite and manage members, but not other admins or the Owner.
invite.roleHintMember: Members connect their own devices. They can’t invite or manage others unless you allow it below.
invite.olderServer: This server needs the device name now. Update the server to let recipients choose it.
invite.usesHint: Each use adds one device with its own keys. Device limits still apply.
invite.usesInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
invite.createFailed: Couldn’t create the invitation. Try again.

share.qrNote: Scan this instead of copying the code.

localNetworks.title: Local networks on {{name}}
localNetworks.description: Share private networks behind {{name}}, such as a home network, with your other devices.
localNetworks.reach: Devices with mutual access reach these networks through your VPS while {{name}} allows mutual access too, and so does a device paired to start connections to {{name}}. Hosts on these networks can answer, but can’t start connections into SirinVPN.
localNetworks.label: Networks
localNetworks.hint: One private IPv4 network per line, /20 or smaller, such as 192.168.1.0/24. Leave empty to stop sharing.
localNetworks.invalid: Not a private IPv4 network of /20 or smaller: {{networks}}
localNetworks.hostBits: {{network}} isn’t the start of its network. Use {{canonical}}.
localNetworks.linux: {{name}} must run SirinVPN on Linux with IPv4 forwarding on:
localNetworks.router: A WireGuard-only router forwards with its own settings.
localNetworks.apply: Each device applies a change when it next connects.
localNetworks.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the local networks. Try again.

pairs.title: Pairs for {{name}}
pairs.description: A pair lets two devices reach each other even when mutual access is off.
pairs.directionHint: The arrow points from the device that starts connections; the other only answers. Starting connections to a device that shares local networks also reaches them.
pairs.replaces: {{name}} is already paired. Adding replaces its direction.
pairs.saveFailed: Couldn’t change the pair. Try again.

policy.title: Access policy for {{name}}
policy.cancelsInvitations: Saving cancels pending invitations for or from {{name}}.
policy.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the access policy. Try again.
policy.deviceLimitHint: Leave empty for no limit. Revoke extra devices before lowering it.
policy.expiresHint: Your local time. Leave empty to never expire.
policy.expiresPast: This time has passed. The member loses access as soon as you save.

permission.manageMutualAccess: Manage mutual access for their devices
permission.managePortForwards: Open public internet ports to their devices

error.limit: Enter a limit from 1 to 222, or leave it empty.
error.expires: Enter a valid date and time.
error.format: Use one window per line, like {{example}}.
error.order: Each window must end after it starts, on the same day. Use 24:00 for midnight.
error.overlap: Use up to 28 windows that don’t overlap.

schedule.label: Weekly schedule
schedule.title: Weekly access
schedule.allWeek: Access is allowed all week. Add an interval to limit it to certain hours.
schedule.localTime: Times are in your time zone ({{zone}}). Daylight saving changes can shift them by an hour.
schedule.incomplete: Choose a start and end time for interval {{number}}.
schedule.sameTime: Interval {{number}} starts and ends at the same time. Use 00:00 to 00:00 for a whole day.
schedule.textHint: One window per line in UTC, like {{example}}. Up to 28.

ports.title: Port forwarding
ports.unavailable: Repair this server to enable port forwarding.
ports.exposure: Anyone on the internet can reach a forwarded service.
ports.noTargetsMember: You can’t forward ports to any device. Ask an Owner or Admin.
ports.noTargets: Add an active device to forward ports.
ports.publicPortLow: Use a port from 1024 to 65535. Lower ports are reserved.
ports.previewEmpty: Enter both ports to see a preview.
ports.previewInvalid: Fix the highlighted fields to see a preview.
ports.full: All {{max}} ports are in use. Close one to open another.
ports.visitorAddress: The service sees visitors as <address>{{address}}</address>, not their real IP.
ports.connectFirst: Connect to {{server}} to manage port forwarding.

rename.title: Rename {{name}}
rename.description: Everyone who manages this VPN sees the new name.
rename.label: Device name
rename.invalid: Remove line breaks and other control characters.

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revoke.message: Its VPN and management access stops immediately.

allowMutual.title: Allow mutual access for {{name}}?
allowMutual.message: It can reach other devices that also allow mutual access.

isolate.title: Isolate {{name}}?
isolate.message: Its direct connections to other devices stop. Internet access continues.

openPort.title: Open public port {{publicPort}}?
openPort.message: {{protocol}} port {{publicPort}} will forward to {{member}} / {{device}}, port {{devicePort}}. Anyone on the internet can try to reach it.

makeAdmin.title: Make {{name}} an admin?
makeAdmin.message: Admins can invite and manage members.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership to {{name}}?
transfer.message: {{device}} ({{fingerprint}}) and their other devices become Owner devices. This device becomes an admin.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.message_one: {{count}} device loses access until reactivated. Pending invitations and key changes are cancelled.
suspend.message_other: {{count}} devices lose access until reactivated. Pending invitations and key changes are cancelled.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivate.message: Their devices regain access with saved settings. Cancelled invitations aren’t restored.

revokeAll.title: Revoke all devices for {{name}}?
revokeAll.message_one: This permanently removes {{count}} device, plus port forwards and invitations. They’ll need a new invitation to return.
revokeAll.message_other: This permanently removes {{count}} devices, plus port forwards and invitations. They’ll need a new invitation to return.

cancelInvitation.title: Cancel “{{name}}”?
cancelInvitation.message: The code stops working immediately. Devices that already joined keep their access.

removePair.title: Remove the pair {{first}} and {{second}}?
removePair.message: They can no longer reach each other unless both allow mutual access.

notice.transferred: {{name}} is now the Owner. This device is an admin.

rejected.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
rejected.used: This invitation has already been used or was cancelled. Ask for a new one.
rejected.invalid: This isn’t a valid invitation code. Check that you copied all of it, or ask for a new one.

join.ownerDevice: Adds this device to {{name}}’s Owner access.
join.ownerPower: Owner devices can manage the server, every member and every device. Join only if you expected this.
join.renameLater: You can rename it later in Devices.

error.load: Couldn’t load devices from the server.
error.rename: Couldn’t rename the device. Try again.
error.revoke: Couldn’t revoke the device. Try again.
error.mutualAccess: Couldn’t change device access. Try again.
error.portsInvalid: Choose a device, a public port (1024–65535) and a device port (1–65535).
error.openPort: Couldn’t open the port. Try again.
error.closePort: Couldn’t close the port. Try again.
error.cancelInvitation: Couldn’t cancel the invitation. Try again.
error.role: Couldn’t change the role. Try again.
error.revokeAll: Couldn’t revoke the member’s devices. Refresh to see their current state.
error.suspension: Couldn’t change the member’s access. Refresh to see their current state.

wireguard.title: Add WireGuard device
wireguard.readyFirst: Name the device to create it.
wireguard.description: For iPhone, iPad, Mac or a router running the official WireGuard app. It connects over Direct UDP only and cannot manage this server or use the other transports.
wireguard.descriptionReady: Scan this in the WireGuard app, or import the saved file. It is shown only once.
wireguard.fileHint: Optional. Save a .conf file for a router or for importing later.
wireguard.pickerFailed: The file picker could not open.
wireguard.failed: The WireGuard device could not be added.
wireguard.secretWarning: This QR code and file contain the device’s private key. Anyone who has them can use this VPN. Delete the file after importing it.
wireguard.revokeHint: Revoke the device from this list if the QR code or file is lost or shared.
